title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Ren Specials
justification: AniList 20777 (SPECIAL, 7 episode(s) from 2014-03-19) is AniDB 9874's special(s) S8-S14, aired 2014-03-19 to 2014-09-17. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 9874. The parent's row start 8 end 14 offset 20 puts S8-S14 on TVDB 0x28-0x34.
